_comment: Per-dataset overrides for scripts/dataset_sweep.py, keyed by filename.
Every field is optional. Omit a dataset entirely and the sweep confirms
whatever schema detection suggested -- which is worth doing deliberately,
because it exercises the same guess the user is offered at the checkpoint.
'note' is the point of each entry: it says which dataset *shape* the file
is standing in for, so a sweep's table reads as coverage rather than as a
list of filenames. The shapes still uncovered are listed at the bottom.
'in_repo': false marks a dataset that lives only on the machine running
the sweep. Only data/examples/*.csv is committed -- the bigger and messier
shapes are exactly the ones too large to version -- so those entries are
exempt from the test that checks every named file actually exists.

datasets.note: baseline: small, mixed numeric + categorical, binary target, PII columns present
regression route: KFold, no resampling, r2/RMSE, plus a date column and an ordinal (epc_rating)
wide: 122 columns, 137 categorical levels, 6 real drivers among 116 noise columns -- the prompt budget, the one-hot expansion, and SHAP's name mapping at scale
imbalanced + 50k rows: the SMOTE-inside-the-fold path, and the first size at which EDA cost is visible
datasets._in_repo_note: Too large to commit; regenerate with data/_make_fraud.py.
datasets._time_column_note: Sent only on a build with time-ordered CV (PR #26). Until that merges the API rejects the field and the sweep records a confirm failure -- which is the honest outcome, not a random split reported as ordered.

datasets.note: multiclass: 4 classes at 40/30/20/10, for the OvR macro ROC-AUC branch and the deliberately absent PR-AUC. Rarest class is ~70 rows, so it is also the first multiclass target SMOTE has resampled

numeric-only: not one object or datetime column, the only condition under which clustering picks K-Means. Also puts an empty categorical branch list through the preprocessor and gives SHAP no one-hot names to map back

high-cardinality text: 'subject' is 96% unique free text (the 'text' role, where FrequencyEncoder collapses to near-constant), 'customer_id' is ~160 levels with real repetition (the case frequency encoding exists for)
small n: 150 rows with exactly 4 positives, which trips two minimums on one run -- stratification drops from 5 folds to 4, and SMOTE declines because 4 is under its floor of 6

messy, gate probe: the duplicate 'amount' header is terminal -- inspect_csv rejects the upload rather than let pandas rename it to amount.1 behind the user's back. This file therefore tests one validation rule and never reaches the pipeline; the renamed variant below carries the rest of the mess

messy, pipeline probe: an all-null column, numbers mixed with prose in one column, unicode and whitespace-padded names, currency and thousands separators, four spellings of one country, three date formats, 32 duplicate rows. ~60% of the signal is inside the mess, so the score measures how much cleaning recovered

_shapes_note: Emptied once the five shapes above were generated and swept. The list was never meant to be permanent -- add to it when a route is identified that no dataset takes, and clear entries only after a sweep has actually run them.
